name: Punam Verma
title: Broadcast journalist, presenter and media trainer
bio_short: Broadcast journalist, presenter and media trainer. BBC News journalist and BBC WM presenter. Hosted Dubai One TV's longest-running English-language show, Out and About. Freelance producer and host at Dubai Eye Radio 103.8. Trains in English.
bio: Punam is a broadcast journalist, presenter and media trainer with a career spanning radio, television and film. She began as a news journalist and breakfast show host at BBC WM in Birmingham before working as a BBC News journalist. She was then recruited by Dubai One TV to host and write their first English-language lifestyle show, Out and About, which became the channel's longest-running English programme. The show saw her interviewing international figures and travelling to destinations across the UAE and beyond. She is a freelance producer and host for Dubai Eye Radio 103.8.  Beyond broadcasting, Punam has worked as a filmmaker, with her debut documentary premiering at the Dubai International Film Festival as a Muhr Awards finalist. She is an accomplished international MC who has hosted events for the President of the Maldives and members of the Dubai Royal Family. She has also served as a presenter for CNN, Showtime and MBC. She holds a Postgraduate Diploma in Journalism from Birmingham City University.  At ISOC, Punam delivers media training, public speaking and presentation skills programmes. Her experience as a working broadcaster gives her an authentic understanding of what makes someone effective on camera, on air and on stage. Punam is based between London and Dubai and trains in English.

At ISOC, Punam delivers media training, public speaking and presentation skills programmes. Her experience as a working broadcaster gives her an authentic understanding of what makes someone effective on camera, on air and on stage. She helps participants develop natural, confident delivery and the ability to engage audiences in live and recorded formats. Her experience across both UK and Middle Eastern media makes her adaptable to different cultural and media contexts. Punam is based between London and Dubai and trains in English.   ## BATCH 4 — non-website trainers
